notes: PDF check: the paper identifies 16 HiVel candidates from Gaia DR1/TGAS plus LAMOST/LSS-GAC DR4, but Sec 4.3 explicitly marks only HiVel14, HiVel15, and HiVel16 as unbound; this draft records those three unbound cases. LSS-GAC DR4 is the LAMOST Galactic Anti-Center catalog/release used for line-of-sight velocities and stellar parameters, so LAMOST DR4 vs LSS-GAC DR4 is not a conflict in this paper. Sec 2.2: distances are Astraatmadja & Bailer-Jones (2016) Bayesian TGAS parallax distances; Galactic coordinates l,b and distance are transformed to Galactocentric X,Y,Z with R_sun=8.2 kpc. Sec 2.2: velocities use V_LSR=220 km/s and solar peculiar motion (10.0, 11.0, 7.0) km/s. Sec 4.3: orbital/boundness discussion uses the McMillan (2017) Galactic potential. Table 2 prints l,b but no RA/Dec, so observed_phase_space.ra/dec are left absent; this is valid because RA/Dec quantities are optional and should not be hand-converted from l,b.
